# spacingBreaks

Kind: presentation setting.

`spacingBreaks` controls generated spacing after metadata presentation or separators.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| JSON type | integer |
| Constraints | Must be 0 or greater. |
| Default behavior | The default manifest uses `2`. |
| Controls | Generated spacing before the document body. |

Markdown emits this many `<br>` lines. Plain text emits this many physical blank lines using the file newline style.

See [presentation](../presentation.md).
